name: Common
description: The trade tongue shared by most civilised humanoids.

name: Abyssal
description: The speech of demons and the chaotic evil planes.

name: Aquan
description: The tongue of water-based creatures and the Plane of Water.

name: Auran
description: The tongue of air-based creatures and the Plane of Air.

name: Celestial
description: The speech of good outsiders and the upper planes.

name: Draconic
description: The language of dragons, kobolds and troglodytes, and of much arcane writing.

name: Druidic
description: The secret language of druids, who are forbidden to teach it to nondruids.

name: Dwarven
description: The language of dwarves.

name: Elven
description: The language of elves.

name: Giant
description: The language of giants, ogres and trolls.

name: Gnome
description: The language of gnomes.

name: Gnoll
description: The language of gnolls.

name: Goblin
description: The language of goblins, hobgoblins and bugbears.

name: Halfling
description: The language of halflings.

name: Ignan
description: The tongue of fire-based creatures and the Plane of Fire.

name: Infernal
description: The speech of devils and the lawful evil planes.

name: Orc
description: The language of orcs.

name: Sylvan
description: The language of dryads, nymphs and other fey.

name: Terran
description: The tongue of earth-based creatures and the Plane of Earth.

name: Undercommon
description: The trade tongue of the Underdark, spoken by drow and their neighbours.
